before.answer:
A correct sketch has energy horizontally, particle population per energy interval vertically, and one rising then falling long-tailed curve [1]; the catalysed Ea lies left of the uncatalysed Ea, with a greater area beyond the lower threshold [1].

One normalized energy distribution at fixed relative temperature 2.5. The catalysed threshold is at energy 4 and uncatalysed at 7. The extra region between thresholds represents additional particles energetic enough for the lower-barrier route.
